Persistence of rank order of blood pressure in individuals as they grow older</strong></p><ul>\n<li><strong>\"Tracking\"</strong> in epidemiology refers to the phenomenon whereby an individual's <strong>relative position (rank/percentile) within a population distribution of a measurement tends to persist over time</strong> as the population as a whole ages.
